providers.name: Alibaba Cloud Bailian
providers.note: One key for chat, hands, pictures and clips. Signs up accounts with a mainland China identity only; the international edition (dashscope-intl) does not carry these models. Pictures and clips go through Model Studio's own API, which nanoMuse speaks.
providers.note_zh: 一把 key 覆盖对话、手、画图和视频。只给中国大陆身份注册；国际版（dashscope-intl）没有这几个模型。画图和视频走百炼自己的接口，nanoMuse 已支持。

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.note: deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) reads pictures; deepseek-v4-pro is text only. No image or video models.
providers.note_zh: deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）能看图；deepseek-v4-pro 只处理文字。没有图像和视频模型。

providers.name: Kimi (Moonshot AI)
providers.note: Two editions: api.moonshot.cn for mainland China, api.moonshot.ai elsewhere, each with its own console and keys. kimi-k2.6 and kimi-k3 read pictures. The phone apps can sign in with a Kimi account (device code) instead of a key.
providers.note_zh: 两个版本：中国大陆用 api.moonshot.cn，海外用 api.moonshot.ai，各自有控制台和 key。kimi-k2.6、kimi-k3 能看图。手机 App 可以用 Kimi 账号登录（设备码），不用贴 key。

providers.name: Zhipu GLM
providers.note: glm-4.6v reads pictures; pictures are drawn by glm-image or cogview-4 through /images/generations.
providers.note_zh: glm-4.6v 能看图；画图用 glm-image 或 cogview-4，走 /images/generations。

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.note: Many open models behind one key; model ids carry the maker's prefix. Pictures through /images/generations (Qwen-Image, Kolors, FLUX).
providers.note_zh: 一把 key 后面是许多开源模型，模型 id 带厂商前缀。画图走 /images/generations（Qwen-Image、Kolors、FLUX）。

providers.name: Volcengine Ark (Doubao)
providers.note: Model ids are dated deployments; the live list has the exact ones. Doubao Seed 2.0 reads pictures; Seedream draws them through /images/generations. Seedance video uses Ark's own task API, which nanoMuse does not speak, so clips are left out.
providers.note_zh: 模型 id 带日期后缀，以实时列表为准。豆包 Seed 2.0 能看图；Seedream 画图走 /images/generations。Seedance 视频走方舟自己的任务接口，nanoMuse 还不支持，所以不列视频。

providers.name: MiniMax
providers.note: Two editions: api.minimaxi.com for mainland China, api.minimax.io elsewhere. MiniMax-M3 reads pictures; the M2 series is text only.
providers.note_zh: 两个版本：中国大陆用 api.minimaxi.com，海外用 api.minimax.io。MiniMax-M3 能看图；M2 系列只处理文字。

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.note: One account, one key, pay as you go, international cards; models carry the maker's prefix. Pictures only through image-output models (openai/gpt-image-2, google/gemini-2.5-flash-image, bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5) on OpenRouter's Image API (/api/v1/images). The phone apps can sign in to OpenRouter instead of pasting a key.
providers.note_zh: 一个账号一把 key，按量付费，国际信用卡；模型带厂商前缀。画图只能用出图模型（openai/gpt-image-2、google/gemini-2.5-flash-image、bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5），走 OpenRouter 的图像接口（/api/v1/images）。手机 App 可以直接登录 OpenRouter，不用贴 key。

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.note: With an API key: chat, hands and pictures (gpt-image-2.5-flare / gpt-image-2 through /images/generations). Signed in with a ChatGPT plan (the Codex OAuth): chat and hands only; the Codex backend has no image or video endpoints. OpenAI's terms cover using a ChatGPT plan inside OpenAI's own Codex; other apps have had this access cut off before (OpenCode, January 2026). If it stops working, an API key does.
providers.note_zh: 用 API key：对话、手、画图（gpt-image-2.5-flare / gpt-image-2，走 /images/generations）。用 ChatGPT 订阅登录（Codex 的 OAuth）：只有对话和手，Codex 后端没有图像和视频接口。OpenAI 的条款只允许在它自己的 Codex 里使用 ChatGPT 订阅；其他应用的这条路曾被切断过（OpenCode，2026 年 1 月）。如果哪天不能用了，API key 还能用。

providers.name: Anthropic Claude
providers.note: The Messages API, not OpenAI's shape; every current Claude model reads pictures. No image or video models. The phone apps can sign in with a Claude account instead of a key.
providers.note_zh: 用的是 Messages 接口，不是 OpenAI 格式；现行 Claude 模型都能看图。没有图像和视频模型。手机 App 可以用 Claude 账号登录，不用贴 key。

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.note: Google's OpenAI-compatible layer. Gemini models read pictures. Pictures through /images/generations work with gemini-2.5-flash-image and gemini-3-pro-image-preview only; the newer 3.1 image models are not served there. Veo video is not on the compatible layer, so clips are left out.
providers.note_zh: Google 的 OpenAI 兼容层。Gemini 模型能看图。走 /images/generations 画图只支持 gemini-2.5-flash-image 和 gemini-3-pro-image-preview，更新的 3.1 出图模型不在兼容层上。Veo 视频不走兼容层，所以不列视频。

providers.name: xAI Grok
providers.note: grok-4.7 reads pictures (JPEG and PNG). Pictures through /images/generations with grok-imagine-image-2.0. Grok Imagine video uses xAI's own endpoints, so clips are left out.
providers.note_zh: grok-4.7 能看图（JPEG、PNG）。画图走 /images/generations，模型 grok-imagine-image-2.0。Grok Imagine 视频走 xAI 自己的接口，所以不列视频。

providers.name: Groq
providers.note: Fast hosting of open models. qwen/qwen3.8-27b reads pictures; gpt-oss and Llama do not. No image or video models.
providers.note_zh: 开源模型的高速托管。qwen/qwen3.8-27b 能看图；gpt-oss 和 Llama 不能。没有图像和视频模型。

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.note: mistral-large-2512, mistral-medium-2508, mistral-small-2506 and the Ministral 3 models read pictures. No image or video models.
providers.note_zh: mistral-large-2512、mistral-medium-2508、mistral-small-2506 和 Ministral 3 系列能看图。没有图像和视频模型。

providers.name: OpenCode Zen
providers.note: OpenCode's own gateway: pay per request from a balance, a key made in the OpenCode console, and a few free models beside the paid ones. Chat answers on the OpenAI shape; the GPT, Claude and Gemini ids on the same host speak the Responses, Messages and Google shapes, which this entry does not reach, and the vision model OpenCode lists is deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, the id DeepSeek has retired on its own platform, so the hands are not claimed here. OpenCode publishes no plan sign-in, only a key.
providers.note_zh: OpenCode 自己的网关：按请求从余额里扣费，key 在 OpenCode 控制台申请，付费模型之外还有几个免费的。对话走 OpenAI 格式；同一域名上的 GPT、Claude、Gemini 走 Responses、Messages 和 Google 格式，本条目到不了；它列的视觉模型是 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp，这个 id 在 DeepSeek 自家平台上已经退役，所以「动手」不列入。OpenCode 没有套餐登录，只有 key。

providers.name: OpenCode Go
providers.note: A subscription for coding agents: Go ($10 a month) or Go Plus ($40) in the OpenCode console, then a key made there; usage is counted per model against monthly, weekly and five hour limits. OpenCode asks every client to name itself and to send one stable id per conversation in x-opencode-session: the runtime sends both, the desktop reaches Go through its model adapter's own OpenCode Go route, which sends the id and speaks each model's shape, and the phone apps send an id per chat (a hash of its first message, the same on every turn). Outside the desktop only the OpenAI shape is reached, which is where the open coding models answer; the GPT, Grok, Claude, MiniMax and Qwen ids speak the Responses and Messages shapes. The one vision model OpenCode lists (deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp) is an id DeepSeek has retired on its own platform, so the hands are not claimed here. OpenCode publishes no plan sign-in, only a key.
providers.note_zh: 面向编程智能体的订阅：在 OpenCode 控制台订阅 Go（每月 10 美元）或 Go Plus（每月 40 美元），再在那里申请 key；用量按模型计，分每月、每周和每 5 小时三档上限。OpenCode 要求每个客户端说明自己是谁，并在 x-opencode-session 里为每个对话带上一个固定的 id：运行时两样都发；桌面版通过模型适配器自带的 OpenCode Go 路由访问，这条路由会带上 id，也按每个模型自己的格式说话；手机端为每个聊天带一个 id（由第一条消息算出，每一轮都一样）。桌面版以外只走 OpenAI 格式，开源编程模型都在这个格式上；GPT、Grok、Claude、MiniMax 和 Qwen 走 Responses 和 Messages 格式。它列的那个视觉模型（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp）在 DeepSeek 自家平台上已经退役，所以「动手」不列入。OpenCode 没有套餐登录，只有 key。

providers.name: Ollama
providers.note: Runs on this machine, no key, nothing leaves it. Hands need a model that reads pictures (a vision model such as a Qwen VL build); the model list says which.
providers.note_zh: 跑在本机，不要 key，什么都不出去。手需要能看图的模型（例如 Qwen 的 VL 版本），模型列表里能看出来。

providers.name: LM Studio
providers.note: LM Studio's local server, OpenAI-compatible, no key. Vision only if the loaded model has it.
providers.note_zh: LM Studio 的本地服务，OpenAI 兼容，不要 key。装了能看图的模型才能用手。

providers.name: vLLM
providers.note: A vLLM server you run yourself; a key only if you started it with one. Vision only if the served model has it.
providers.note_zh: 自己跑的 vLLM 服务；启动时设了 key 才需要填。服务的模型能看图才能用手。

providers.name: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
providers.name_zh: 任何 OpenAI 兼容接口
providers.note: A gateway, a relay, a server of your own: paste the address (usually ending in /v1) and say what it can do; the person sets the capabilities.
providers.note_zh: 网关、中转、自己的服务：贴地址（一般以 /v1 结尾），再说明它能做什么，能力由你勾选。
